## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 175 captures during January 2023. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. The recorded volume should continue to be monitored alongside the quality and reporting measures below.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 1.7. This indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while a small number could not be graded. The clinic should continue to review image capture practice and identify any recurring operational issues that may affect image usability.

## Grading

A total of 46 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This measure should be considered alongside the monthly activity and image quality results when reviewing service performance.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues consistently will support follow-up and help identify whether further operational review is required.
